items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: The interviewer mentions Herbie Hancock in the context of mid-70s fusion, but the interviewee (Doug Carn) does not mention Herbie Hancock in his response, nor does he describe any personal or professional interaction with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. And so you know I put a lot of thought in it you know, and to tell people you spent a great deal of your time thinking. They can’t get to that you know. You know they can’t get to that. He’s supposed to be spending a great deal of your time putting stress on your back and lifting weights you know.
The people that were recording a great deal in the mid-70s, there was a lot of heavy duty fusion with Herbie Hancock and Mahavishnu, Weather Report.
